# TrailGroove Magazine

> > TrailGroove Magazine is a hiking and backpacking publication featuring trail guides, gear reviews, and outdoor adventure stories.

Founded by Aaron Zagrodnick, TrailGroove Magazine LLC publishes digital issues covering iconic trails like Goat Rocks Loop, Zion, and the Florida Trail, along with gear reviews and backpacking route information.
